dedupe_keys.name: de zonas de servicio portuarias de espana

description: de Zonas de servicio portuarias de España is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.puertos.es. Download service (WFS) of the port service areas include cartographic and alphanumeric information on the land service area and water zones I and II. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WFS spanish port service area" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Puertos, Zona de servicio terrestre, Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales, Zona I y II de aguas, IDEE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
